quotes.author: John Riddick
quotes.text: We took a tour in the evening of Downtown Austin, Zilker Park and the trail of Christmas lights. It was such an amazing experience! The pilot was so friendly and informative! I would highly recommend this tour company to everyone! It was an experience of a lifetime! Great job!

quotes.author: SheLovesEggs
quotes.text: The best pilot anyone could ask for, the lady i spoke to over the phone was very helpful with my questions. The pilot definitely knew what he was doing and even did some cool tricks for us in the helicopter, id recommend night rides 101%.

quotes.author: Paul Sanchez
quotes.text: What an Adventure this was! Hands down BEST experience EVER.! Our Pilot Meech was amazing, Big shout-out to her for showing us a REALLY Great time! The Best Helicopter Tours in All of Austin.!

quotes.author: Bryan Bousquet
quotes.text: What an AMAZING experience! My wife and I did the sunset tour with doors off (highly recommend for a little extra $).

quotes.author: Jesse Lewelling
quotes.text: It was our first time in a helicopter. It was a great experience, downtown Austin is beautiful at night.
